company.shortDescription: Lightfield is a software company that develops an AI-native customer relationship management platform that captures customer interactions.
company.description: Lightfield is a software company that develops an AI-native customer relationship management platform. Its CRM captures customer interactions from emails, meetings, calls, Slack, and other systems and organizes them into a contextual model of customer relationships, accounts, opportunities, and contacts. The platform uses AI agents to perform tasks such as account research, meeting preparation, opportunity qualification, follow-ups, pipeline generation, and customer outreach. Its data model maintains the current state of CRM records as well as the history of changes and interactions over time. Lightfield also provides tools for building agents, automations, and workflows using natural-language prompts, APIs, MCP, and a command-line interface. The platform supports data migration from existing CRM systems and can operate alongside systems such as Salesforce and HubSpot through two-way synchronization.
